verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is documented as a visual automation builder where workspace members define sequences of automated actions (blocks) that fire on event triggers such as "When a new deal is created." Downstream steps include web-research enrichment and lead scoring/routing agents. Users can also ask Attio to build workflows from a described goal, and the App SDK adds custom triggers and steps, including trigger activation and resume-callback handlers. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of native triggers and conditional rule/branching logic beyond the single deal-created example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
